title: Virtual Radiosonde Plotter: Atmospheric Sounding Analysis & Skew-T Visualization Tool
description:
Virtual Radiosonde Plotter is a professional desktop application for atmospheric sounding data analysis, thermodynamic profiling, and high-resolution Skew-T Log-P diagram visualization.

Key Features:

  • Asynchronous Data Ingestion: Automated Open-Meteo ERA5 / Weather Model 19-level profile fetching with global geocoding support.
  • Thermodynamic Profiling & Cloud Base Height: Calculates Surface Conditions, LCL Pressure/Temperature, Cloud Base Height (zLCL in meters and feet), LFC, EL, SBCAPE, MLCAPE, MUCAPE, SBCIN, MLCIN, MUCIN, PWAT, K-Index, Total Totals, Lifted Index, Showalter Index, SWEAT Index, and Storm Relative Helicity (SRH).
  • Tropical Severe Weather Risk Assessment: Automated threat assessment for Thunderstorm potential, Heavy Rain / Moisture supply, and Low-level Wind Shear based on tropical thresholds.
  • Publication-Quality Visualization: Standard Skew-T Log-P diagrams with dry/moist adiabats, mixing ratio lines, parcel path trajectories, CAPE/CIN shading, wind barbs, and dark/light mode toggles.
  • RAOB Software Compatibility: Export profile data natively into RAOB Sounding Format (.rsf), RAOB Native format (.env), RAOB/NOAA ASCII text (.txt), and standard CSV formats.

Developed by Widhyatma (Jerukagung Meteorologi). Built using Python, PySide6 (Qt6), MetPy, and Matplotlib.
